class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        a=nums[0]
        sc=[(a,1)]
        ans=0
        if a==k:ans+=1
        for a in nums[1:]:
            nsc=[]
            now,cnt=a,1
            for s,c in sc:
                s&=a
                if s==now:
                    cnt+=c
                else:
                    nsc.append((now,cnt))
                    if now==k:ans+=cnt
                    now,cnt=s,c
            nsc.append((now,cnt))
            if now == k: ans += cnt
            sc=nsc
        return ans

class Solution:
    def countSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        ans = 0
        cnt = defaultdict(int)
        cnt[nums[0]] = 1
        ans = cnt[k]
        for i in range(1, n):
            x = nums[i]
            new = defaultdict(int)
            for y in cnt:
                new[y & x] += cnt[y]
            new[x] += 1
            cnt = new
            ans += cnt[k]
        return ans
